question: List the names and email addresses of the policyholders behind our 10 largest claims in 2026.

report.interpretation: The user asked for the names and email addresses of the policyholders behind the 10 largest 2026 claims. These are personal data fields.
report.answer: I can't share policyholder names or email addresses with the Claims VP role. Only the fraud team lead can see personal data. I can list the 10 largest 2026 claims without personal identifiers, for example claim ID, policy ID, product, cause, state and incurred amount. I can also give the amounts by policyholder ID. Tell me if you want either one. The fraud team lead can request the named list.
open_questions: Do you want the 10 largest 2026 claims listed with non-personal identifiers only? If so, should 'largest' mean incurred (paid plus reserve), and should 2026 be by loss date or report date?
